objective: Ship a public early access page for VisePanda that collects an email plus at most three qualifying answers into a mainland-accessible online table, and states that the iOS and Android apps are in development.
acceptedIssue: direct operator request 2026-08-24: build the VP Early Access page in a new repository
intendedNextAgent: operator, then codex for follow-up issues
assumptions: Audience is both mainland and overseas visitors, so the page ships bilingual EN/ZH with a nav toggle and never calls a third-party service from the visitor's browser.
The operator owns the Feishu account; no account was created on their behalf.
No real launch date has been approved, so ACCESS_WINDOW ships as a non-binding phrase.
Signup counts, press logos and testimonials were omitted rather than fabricated.
decisions: Custom-designed form posting to an own-origin route handler, instead of embedding a Tencent/Wenjuanxing iframe. Keeps the VisePanda design intact, keeps submission latency off a China-hosted service for overseas visitors, and makes the submit event instrumentable.
Storage is a provider adapter (console | feishu | webhook). Default console so the page runs with zero configuration; feishu is the intended production provider.
The map is a node-and-arc city constellation, not a national outline. Publishing a China map in the mainland requires an approved base map and a review number under the Map Management Regulations.
Fonts are self-hosted via next/font because fonts.googleapis.com is unreachable from mainland China.
All copy is centralised in lib/copy.ts as { en, zh } pairs.
architectureContracts: POST /api/waitlist accepts { email, timing?, source?, feature?, lang?, company? } and returns { ok: true } or { error: 'email' | 'rate' | 'server' }.
A honeypot hit returns 200 { ok: true } and is never persisted.
Answer values not present in QUESTIONS in lib/copy.ts are dropped to an empty string, never persisted raw.
The Feishu Bitable table must expose exactly these text columns: Email, Timing, Source, Feature, Lang, Referrer, User Agent, Submitted At.
Secrets are supplied only through environment variables and never committed.

verification.summary: Next.js 16 production build succeeds; / is static, /api/waitlist is dynamic.

verification.command: curl -X POST /api/waitlist (valid, invalid email, honeypot, unknown answer value, rate limit)
verification.summary: 200 for valid, 400 error=email for malformed address, 200 with no persistence for a honeypot hit, unknown answer values dropped to empty string, 429 from the 6th request in a minute.

verification.command: browser verification at 1440x900 and 375x812, EN and ZH
verification.summary: No console errors, no horizontal overflow, form step 1 to step 2 to success flow works, Chinese headings break cleanly.
Blocked on operator credentials. The provider is implemented and typechecked but has never written a real Bitable row.

blockers: The Feishu provider cannot be verified end to end until the operator creates the app and supplies the four environment variables.
risks: Vercel's default domains are not reliably reachable from mainland China. If mainland visitors are in scope, hosting must be chosen accordingly; the storage provider does not solve reachability.
The rate limiter is in-memory and per instance. It resets on deploy and does not coordinate across serverless instances.
The page currently carries no social proof. Waitlist pages convert materially better with a real signup counter or early-user quotes, which can only be added once they exist.
operatorActions: Create the Feishu app and Bitable table by following docs/setup-feishu.md, then set the six environment variables in the hosting dashboard. Do not paste the App Secret into chat or into the repository.
Decide and set ACCESS_WINDOW in lib/copy.ts to a real launch window, or confirm it should stay non-binding.
Decide the hosting provider, taking mainland reachability and any ICP filing requirement into account.
Confirm the contact address in the footer (currently hello@visepanda.com) and the production domain for NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.
rollback: Set WAITLIST_PROVIDER=console and redeploy: the page keeps working and signups go to the server log instead of Feishu. To remove the page entirely, take down the deployment; nothing in VP-V4 depends on this repository.

nextAction.description: Operator completes docs/setup-feishu.md and sets WAITLIST_PROVIDER=feishu, then confirms one real signup lands in the Bitable table.
nextAction.expectedObservation: A row appears in the Feishu Bitable table with the submitted email and answers.
